acceptance: Explicit operator constraint is authoritative: Codex and Codex2 may use different accounts. Do not hardcode shared-account equivalence, merge their quota groups, treat them as one capacity lane, or globally prohibit mutual review.

Preserve and land the other useful PR #4401 governance rules: direct-component repair versus integration/coordination classification, supervisor-only routine implementation dispatch, governed task packets, no parallel chatbox implementation fleet, no direct pantheon-ci-deploy/dev-root patching, and the narrow temporary live-repair exception.

Replace the stale Codex/Codex2 paragraph with account-neutral text: configured agent identities remain distinct; account/quota/reviewer eligibility follows current configuration and task-scoped live auth/quota evidence, never a global hardcoded equivalence or disqualification.
Start from current origin/dev in a clean governed task worktree. Do not use the dirty shared checkout as delivery authority and do not merge the exact stale PR #4401 policy patch.
After the corrected replacement PR exists, close or supersede PR #4401 and stale evidence PR #4405 with links; do not delete branches or history.

Scope is AGENTS.md plus this task brief/review evidence only. Do not modify supervisor code, config, provider policy, canonical JSON, runtime state, product code, services, deployment, or the 28-task catalog.
Add deterministic policy assertions covering every retained governance clause plus the absence of shared-account, quota-group collapse, and global mutual-review-ban language.
Run git diff --check, policy assertions, commit-trailer validation, and all exact-head GitHub checks. Evidence remains review_pending until Human/Ops exact-head approval.
Deliver a clean task branch and PR to dev, independent Human/Ops exact-head review, governed merge, and canonical done/archive. Rollback is merge-commit revert.
